name: Enterprise Technology Standards and Exceptions
constraints: Architecture Standard profiles WM-KNW-012 and references WM-KNW-013 rules.
Conformance Assessment profiles WM-ACT-034 and pins exact criteria and subject state.
ADR reuses the rationale, occurrence and issued-record triad.
Adoption never proves conformance and conformance never proves adoption.
Exceptions never rewrite assessments or standards.

One standard expression references zero or more WM-KNW-013 rule identities; one rule identity may be referenced by zero or more expressions across standards; the reference is many-to-many and non-owning.
One subject may hold concurrent conformance assessments against different standard expressions, and neither supersedes the other by existing.
Use of a recommended technology is evidence for at most one rule and never aggregates to a whole-system conformance claim.

WM-KNW-012 registered derogations and the WM-KNW-013 waived outcome value are non-mastering projections; each must resolve to exactly one Architecture Exception grant and neither may be authored independently of one.
A criterion outcome is never set to waived because a grant exists; the outcome remains violated and the grant is cited alongside it.

Effective conformance status is a derived read-only projection with no identity and no master; it is recomputed from the pinned assessment plus the grants effective at the queried instant, is never persisted on an assessment or a grant, and is never cited as an assessment outcome.
invariants: The standard expression stores rule references only and never rule text, and never mints a rule identity.
A rule reference set changes only by issuing a successor expression version; the in-force expression is never edited.
The assessment pins one standard expression at one version and one pinned subject state.
Architecture Exception is the sole waiver master.
Assessment outcomes remain independent of exception grants.
holds: Registry allocation is pending and no identifier may be guessed.
Independent Grok review and one frozen semantic audit are pending.
Base specifications and approved relations remain incomplete.
Package conversion and live verification are pending.
WM-ACT-034 carries no assessor competence or impartiality function; three-party distinctness is enforced at the Architecture Exception boundary only and remains unenforced on the assessment side.
